modmenu.descriptionTranslation.bloodvign: Vinyet merah berdenyut dan ikon peringatan saat nyawa rendah.
config.bloodvignette.title: Pengaturan Blood Vignette
config.bloodvignette.enable_vignette.too: Menampilkan vinyet merah berdenyut di tepi layar saat nyawa rendah.
config.bloodvignette.enable_icon.tooltip: Menampilkan ikon peringatan saat nyawa rendah.
config.bloodvignette.health_threshold.to: Efek aktif saat nyawa sama atau di bawah nilai ini (1–20). Default 6 = 3 hati.
config.bloodvignette.heartbeat_volume.to: How loud the heartbeat is. 1 is full volume, 0 is silent.
config.bloodvignette.icon_opacity.toolti: Seberapa buram ikon peringatan (0.0 = tidak terlihat, 1.0 = sepenuhnya terlihat).
config.bloodvignette.icon_pos_y.tooltip: Posisi vertikal (0.0 = atas, 0.18 = area atas, 1.0 = bawah).
config.bloodvignette.fade_in_ms.tooltip: Berapa lama vinyet dan ikon muncul (0–2000 ms). 0 = seketika.
config.bloodvignette.fade_out_ms.tooltip: Berapa lama vinyet dan ikon menghilang (0–2000 ms). 0 = seketika.
config.bloodvignette.position_editor.des: Size, position and opacity are set in the editor. Enable the option below, then click Save & Quit.
config.bloodvignette.position_editor.ope: Turn ON, then click Save & Quit — the editor opens.
config.bloodvignette.position_editor.hin: Drag the icon with LMB. Coarse buttons ±10 / ±1, fine ±0.1 (field 0–1000).
config.bloodvignette.position_editor.uns: Leave without saving? Changes will be lost.
config.bloodvignette.vignette_opacity.to: How strong the red edge effect looks. 1 is full, 0 turns it invisible.
config.bloodvignette.enable_heartbeat.to: Turns the heartbeat audio on or off when your health is low.
